transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess... people just keep telling me I'm not listening. My supervisor at the plant, or my wife. They'll be talking right at me, and... I don't know, a minute later I realize I missed half of it. Then I have to ask them to repeat themselves. It's just... causing some issues, I suppose.
Do you find it hard to focus on tasks or conversations, or do you get distracted easily by things around you?
I don't know. I haven't really noticed being distracted by... stuff around me, if that's what you mean. It's mostly just what I said before. I just sort of... tune out, I guess.
When people are talking to you, do you find it hard to stay engaged because you feel down or uninterested?
No, I wouldn't say that. I'm not... I don't feel down or depressed or anything. And it's not that I don't care about what they're saying. I just... I don't know. It just happens.
Do you often find yourself forgetting things or losing track of what you're supposed to be doing, especially in the middle of tasks?
Not really. I mean... I know what I'm doing at work. It's mostly just routine on the line, so I don't really lose track of the actual job. It's just... like I said, the listening part.
Do you ever find it hard to follow through on instructions or finish tasks, even if they’re not complicated?
No, I finish things. The job isn't really complicated, you just... do what you're supposed to do. I get it done. I don't really have a problem with that part.
Do you remember having this same problem with tuning out or not listening for a long time, maybe even going back to when you were a kid in school?

Yeah... I guess it goes back that far. Even as a kid... teachers were always moving my seat around. I just... couldn't stay put, I guess. I'd, uh, call out answers or get in trouble for butting into what other kids were doing. At least... before middle school, anyway.
As a kid, did you often feel restless or have trouble staying seated, or maybe have trouble waiting your turn?

Yeah... I mean, I guess so. Even now, really. Like at work, I'm supposed to just stay at my station on the line, but... I don't know, I just end up stepping away. I'll go check on something, or grab a tool I probably don't need right that second, or just go talk to one of the guys. Even though I know I'm supposed to be right there. It's just hard to just stand in one spot.
Has this difficulty with staying focused and restless behavior caused problems in your relationships or at work, like reprimands, conflicts, or difficulties keeping up with responsibilities?

Yeah, I guess it has. Work's... well, they've given me some formal warnings about it. It's getting kind of serious. I just... I worry sometimes I might get fired, or, you know, mess something up on the line that causes a safety issue. And at home... my wife gets pretty annoyed. The kids too, sometimes. They say I just... mess up how things are supposed to go instead of helping out.

Outside of work and home, do you find yourself having similar issues with staying focused or feeling restless in other parts of your life, like when you're running errands, driving, or talking with friends?
I don't know... I haven't really noticed, to be honest. I mostly just... go to work and come home. I don't really think about it when I'm out doing other stuff.
